propositions: Add s3 optional-dependency entry to pyproject.toml declaring git-remote-s3>=0.3.2 with a note that it ships the remote helper and is never required by core rebar

Implement require_s3_helper() in src/rebar/_optional.py that verifies both the git-remote-s3 console script is on PATH and the installed distribution version meets the 0.3.2 minimum using stdlib-only version parsing
Add s3 entry to EXTRAS dict in _optional.py to enable consistent error messaging via guard_import and _install_hint when the extra is missing

require_s3_helper() must fail closed: raising OptionalDependencyError with actionable pip install message if the script is absent, dist metadata is missing, version is too old, or version string is unparseable

Unit tests must cover happy path (script present and version 0.3.2+), failure modes (missing script, missing dist metadata), edge cases (older version 0.2.9, newer version 0.4.0, suffixed version 0.3.2.post1, unparseable version), and guard_import behavior
_optional.py must remain stdlib-only with no packaging dependency and no import of git_remote_s3
